svg.text: Conscience — a different approach to AI
An AI system inspired by the principles of living things: continuous, embodied,
reactive, aware and plastic. Where mainstream AI is a request → response pipeline,
Solaris_Ai is a continuously running event loop that ends only when its Lifecycle.die().
loop that never returns to idle.
heartbeat · emits Push every period · absence → Stimulus 'I exist!'
• Will = Need: every output requires an input. There is no real autonomous system.
• Subtraction Principle: prolonged silence becomes its own Stimulus.
• Every Action is also a Stimulus (re-entering the loop) and a Reaction (to whatever pushed it).
anchored on the Core · driven by the heartbeat
ABSENCE OF DATA → SEARCHES AND RESOLUTIONS
For animals, absence does not transfer to need. For the human-like Conscience, AION emits a Stimulus from the absence itself: ‘I exist!’ — the seed of every search.
Bold coloured arrows are the narrative flows. Thin lines underneath are the underlying bus topology, colour-coded by signal type.
Faint red rays radiating from AION show that every module is moved by the heartbeat — ‘everything is driven by the Core’.
the eight typed messages on the bus
quantum of behaviour · also stimulus + reaction
stimulus mapped to meaning · novelty score
change to Inner MAP · fact or boundary
dia / sun balance · fracture forces motion
a constant tension between two pulls; the fracture between them forces motion.
a balanced system is a dead system; opposition keeps it moving
Post-paleorevolution distinction: for animals, absence does not
transfer to need. For the human-like Conscience it does — AION emits a
Stimulus from silence itself, and the system searches.
Output is input-dependent. There is no real free will: Desires arise
from a complexity of stimuli, but moreover from absence.
The unknown that generates the irrational. Rises with novelty; drives
Synthesis and Anticipation. Pushes Logos toward 'union'.
Memory does not live in brain or senses but in their relation. The
Memory/Senses module records both Stimulus and Action.
AION beats · bus broadcasts · modules adapt
Solaris_Ai · conceptual implementation in Python (stdlib only)
